name: editio
description: Evidence-grounded academic writing: structured Markdown drafting, claim and number gates, draft/publish/blind renders, figures, workspace diagnostics, and venue profiles. Includes the humanizer style toolkit. Uses a Promptus evidence store.

interface.longDescription: Turn a Promptus store's validated knowledge into a defensible paper with structured drafting, claim grading, three render modes, figures, and publication gates.
defaultPrompt: Use Editio to scaffold and audit an evidence-grounded paper.
Check this paper's claims against the Promptus store.
